data.title: Comprensión de Lectura
data.context: We normally talk about places and we include the use of adjectives to describe their characteristics. Adjectives are words we use to denote specificities about people, places or situations. Statements QuestionsNegative statements1.Mexico has the ancient ruins of the MayasDoes Mexico have the ancient ruins of the Mayas? No, it does not have the ancient ruins.2.Santa Elena is a small, beautiful and hot town in the South of Venezuela.How is Santa Elena?It is not big or cold. 3.We live in a tiny and cozy town near the borders. Where do you live? I live in a tiny and cozy town but it is not quite. TO CONSIDER​Adjectives come before the object, place or people they describe.They can also be after one verb: My house is beautiful (mainly after To Be).Adjectives do not change because of gender. E.G: She is beautiful / The park is beautiful.Adjectives are not pluralized. E.G: They are talls.❌ They are tall. ✅

data.context: Survivors!​2 years ago, my family and I went to Thailand for spending our holidays. We were having a good time and the city was giving us all what we expected. The days were passing by while we were having the greatest time of our lives; we had the chance to try traditional food when we were visiting local markets. On the fifth day, we were having a great time at the beach when suddenly an alarm sounded…it was announcing that a tsunami was approaching. Everybody was running while we were trying to stay together in the middle of the terrible moment. Some minutes later, a big wave crashed over the land and lots of water was running over people while they were trying to escape… fortunately, we could get to high hill and survived. ​Actions happening in the past. / Actions happening in the past interrupted by another one.Actions happening simultaneously in the past. ​​​​

data.context: We normally talk about places and we include the use of adjectives to describe their characteristics. Adjectives are words we use to denote specificities about people, places or situations. ​​Statements QuestionsNegative statements1.Mexico has the ancient ruins of the MayasDoes Mexico have the ancient ruins of the Mayas? No, it does not have the ancient ruins.2.Santa Elena is a small, beautiful and hot town in the South of Venezuela.How is Santa Elena?It is not big or cold. 3.We live in a tiny and cozy town near the borders. Where do you live? I live in a tiny and cozy town but it is not quite. TO CONSIDER​Adjectives come before the object, place or people they describe.They can also be after one verb: My house is beautiful (mainly after To Be).Adjectives do not change because of gender. E.G: She is beautiful / The park is beautiful.Adjectives are not pluralized. E.G: They are talls.❌ They are tall. ✅
